summary: Adds a `significantDigits` option to prettyBytes so callers can change the default 3-digit rounding. It applies only when the fraction-digit options are unset. Implemented and passing tests, but not committed or released.
narrative: The owner asked for a `significantDigits` option, for example 1337 with 2 digits gives `1.3 kB` and with 4 gives `1.337 kB`. It would apply only when the fraction-digit options are not set, with readme, types and tests. The agent mapped the rounding path and the option docs and test conventions (obs 18, 19), then added the option with a silent fallback for invalid values (obs 20). The first `npm test` failed on lint: seven xo errors, including complexity and trailing spaces (obs 21). After fixing the whitespace and an assertion message, the ava suite passed with 54 tests (obs 22). Memory shows no commit, PR or release yet.
